text:
## Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)  
**Mandatory for High-Risk Customers:**  
**High-Risk Indicators:**
- Beneficial ownership unclear
- Jurisdictions with weak AML controls
- PEP or family member
- Sanctions list match
- Adverse media
- High-value accounts
- Complex transaction patterns
- Non-face-to-face relationship  
**EDD Procedures:**
1. Senior staff approval required
2. Additional identity verification
3. Beneficial ownership investigation (if entity)
4. Source of funds verification
5. Enhanced ongoing monitoring
6. Quarterly risk reassessment
7. Documentation of risk assessment  
**Approval Authority:** Compliance Head

raw_entities.description: Policy mandating Enhanced Due Diligence procedures for high-risk customers. Establishes mandatory risk indicators triggering EDD, defines procedural requirements including senior staff approval, beneficial ownership investigation, source of funds verification, and enhanced ongoing monitoring with quarterly reassessment.
context: Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) Mandatory for High-Risk Customers

EDD Procedures: 1. Senior staff approval required 2. Additional identity verification 3. Beneficial ownership investigation (if entity) 4. Source of funds verification 5. Enhanced ongoing monitoring 6. Quarterly risk reassessment 7. Documentation of risk assessment

raw_entities.name: Senior Staff Approval Requirement for High-Risk Customers
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement that senior staff approval must be obtained before proceeding with account opening or relationship establishment for customers identified as high-risk under EDD criteria.

raw_entities.name: Additional Identity Verification for High-Risk Customers
raw_entities.description: Requirement to conduct additional identity verification beyond standard KYC procedures for customers meeting high-risk indicators under the EDD policy.

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Investigation for Entity Customers
raw_entities.description: Mandatory investigation of beneficial ownership structure when the high-risk customer is a legal entity, to identify and verify the natural persons with ultimate control or beneficial interest.

raw_entities.name: Source of Funds Verification
raw_entities.description: Requirement to verify and document the source of funds for high-risk customers as part of Enhanced Due Diligence procedures.

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Ongoing Monitoring for High-Risk Customers
raw_entities.description: Requirement to implement enhanced ongoing monitoring of high-risk customer accounts and transactions beyond standard monitoring procedures.

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Risk Reassessment for High-Risk Customers
raw_entities.description: Mandatory requirement to conduct and document risk reassessment of high-risk customers on a quarterly basis to determine if risk profile has changed.

raw_entities.name: Documentation of Risk Assessment
raw_entities.description: Requirement to document and retain records of all risk assessments conducted under the Enhanced Due Diligence policy for audit and compliance purposes.

raw_entities.name: Unclear Beneficial Ownership
raw_entities.description: Risk indicator where the beneficial ownership structure of a customer entity is unclear or opaque, triggering Enhanced Due Diligence requirements.

raw_entities.name: Weak AML Control Jurisdictions
raw_entities.description: Risk indicator identifying customers with connections to jurisdictions known to have weak Anti-Money Laundering controls, triggering Enhanced Due Diligence.

raw_entities.name: Politically Exposed Person Status
raw_entities.description: Risk indicator identifying customers who are Politically Exposed Persons or family members of PEPs, triggering Enhanced Due Diligence requirements.

raw_entities.name: Sanctions List Match
raw_entities.description: Risk indicator where a customer matches or potentially matches a sanctions list, triggering Enhanced Due Diligence and potential compliance escalation.

raw_entities.name: Adverse Media
raw_entities.description: Risk indicator where adverse media coverage or negative news is associated with a customer, triggering Enhanced Due Diligence requirements.

raw_entities.name: High-Value Account Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk indicator identifying accounts with high transaction values or balances, which may indicate elevated money laundering or financial crime risk.

raw_entities.name: Complex Transaction Patterns
raw_entities.description: Risk indicator identifying customers with unusual or complex transaction patterns that may indicate money laundering, terrorist financing, or other financial crime.

raw_entities.name: Non-Face-to-Face Relationship Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk indicator where the customer relationship is established or maintained without face-to-face contact, reducing verification capability and triggering Enhanced Due Diligence.

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Ongoing Monitoring System
raw_entities.description: Operational control implementing enhanced monitoring of high-risk customer transactions and account activity beyond standard monitoring procedures.

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Investigation Process
raw_entities.description: Operational control requiring investigation and documentation of beneficial ownership structures for entity customers identified as high-risk.

raw_entities.name: Source of Funds Verification Process
raw_entities.description: Operational control requiring verification and documentation of the source of funds for high-risk customers.

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Risk Reassessment Review
raw_entities.description: Operational control implementing quarterly review and reassessment of high-risk customer risk profiles with documented findings.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Head
raw_entities.description: Senior compliance role with authority to approve Enhanced Due Diligence procedures and high-risk customer onboarding decisions under this policy.

raw_entities.name: Senior Staff
raw_entities.description: Senior staff members responsible for reviewing and approving Enhanced Due Diligence procedures and high-risk customer decisions as required by policy.

raw_entities.name: Enhanced Due Diligence Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: Enhanced identity verification process applied to high-risk customers, including additional verification steps beyond standard KYC procedures.

raw_entities.name: Beneficial Ownership Verification
raw_entities.description: Enhanced due diligence verification process to identify and confirm the beneficial owners of entity customers identified as high-risk.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Customer
raw_entities.description: Customer classification for individuals or entities meeting one or more high-risk indicators under the Enhanced Due Diligence policy, requiring enhanced compliance procedures.
